music.prompt: Big beat breakbeat at exactly 128 BPM for a punchy product comparison motion graphics video: chopped funky drum breaks, a squelchy acid 303 bassline, short brassy synth stabs and a little vinyl scratch; gritty, confident and fun. No vocals. It starts immediately with the drum break playing under a heavy low-pass filter, muffled and tense (0 to 7.5 seconds), with a short rising swell at the end, then at 7.5 seconds the filter snaps open into the full, loud big beat groove with the acid bassline and stabs, gets even bigger at 18.75 seconds, and carries at full energy all the way to the end. It ends cleanly on a downbeat at 36 seconds with no big final hit, no breakdown and no fade.
